verses.73:8: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا

meaning: The root بَتَلَ (batala) means to cut off, sever, or separate something from another. It can also refer to making something obligatory, like a pilgrimage or a gift of a house for life.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
